policy.rule: A task is complete only when every required gate has its own successful evidence. Local verification never implies visual approval, consumer integration, installation, or remote publication.

HARNESS-WORKFLOW-001.title: Adopt the evidence-bound Sprite Harness workflow

specification.note: The canonical lifecycle, evidence boundaries, and publication protocol are documented.

implementation.note: The task ledger, generated views, aggregate verifier, and regression tests exist.

technical.note: The aggregate workflow, pytest, compile, diff, and layered CLI smoke gates passed on the closure source.

visual.note: Workflow infrastructure has no artwork approval gate.

consumer.note: This infrastructure does not itself change a consumer runtime.

publication.note: Commit and push remain separate, explicit maintainer actions.

HARNESS-KEYFRAMES-001.title: Release keyframe tracks and the discrete pulse curve

specification.note: Keyframe and pulse semantics are described in the current working tree.

implementation.note: The implementation is present, but this ledger does not turn uncommitted source into a release.

technical.note: Current-version M3 and M4/M5 acceptance plus the aggregate Harness verification passed.

visual.note: The generic core feature has no character-art approval gate.

consumer.note: All 125 consumer tests passed with the 0.8.0 CLI explicitly pinned; no Harness integration test was skipped.

publication.note: No commit, push, tag, or package release is inferred from local implementation.

REIMU-ACTIONS-001.title: Produce the six-tier work-eating, idle onigiri, and grabbed-drag action set

specification.note: The behavior contract is pinned to the published consumer commit instead of an ambiguous moving branch.

implementation.note: Existing task_2 work is partial coverage; the six tiers and independent grabbed pose are not a finished set.

technical.note: Each authored set needs deterministic plan/render/validate and reduced-motion evidence.

visual.note: Technical QA cannot approve expression, silhouette, scale, timing, or transition quality.

consumer.note: Native runtime state selection, interruption, landing, and tier switching remain separately verifiable.

publication.note: The design commit is published; the complete action delivery is not.
